verdict.rationale: A community user cites outlier analysis as a key Datadog advantage over open-source alternatives (datadog-comm-20). Datadog also documents Watchdog and Monitors pages, though the pack gives only their titles and none of their content. One critic says users sift through dashboards instead of being shown anomalies (datadog-comm-7), but that is an opinion about correlation, not a concrete failure of anomaly detection. missing for 10: first-party doc content describing anomaly/outlier monitor types or Watchdog's automatic detection, evidence of how to enable it without thresholds, hands-on corroboration of alert quality.
